ward_summary.measure_note: Bicyclist-involved crash COUNTS by NYC borough, 2021-01-01 onward (~5 years). Source: NYPD Motor Vehicle Collisions - Crashes (data.cityofnewyork.us, dataset h9gi-nx95). Crashes included where number_of_cyclist_injured>0 OR number_of_cyclist_killed>0. Counts are cyclists killed/injured per CRASH RECORD, not per person -- one crash can involve multiple cyclists. No e-bike flag, no age/sex/helmet data available at this level. NOT exposure-adjusted. 'near_bike_lane' is OSM ~30m proximity; NYC's dense lane network means a high pct is expected citywide.

ward_exposure.measure_note: NOT a true risk-per-rider rate -- same caveat as DC and Chicago. Numerator: ALL cyclist crashes in a borough. Denominator: Citi Bike trips only. Citi Bike coverage is concentrated in Manhattan and Brooklyn; boroughs with few stations will show very high or n/a rates because the denominator is near zero, not because they are proportionally more dangerous per cyclist.
